topic: Prevention of Custodial Torture Violence and Accountability Bill

findings.title: D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal (1997) 1 SCC 416
findings.limitations: Establishes mandatory guidelines for arrest, custody, medical examination, and prohibition of custodial torture under Article 21.

gaps: Absence of a standalone national anti-torture statute with mandatory minimum prison sentences and statutory burden-of-proof reversal.
